roles.name: Solid
roles.description: Occupies space and blocks movement. Players standing on it may not fall off of it.

roles.name: Player
roles.description: The actor moved by the canonical directional input.

roles.name: Sokoban
roles.description: Moves one cell when pushed into an empty cell by the player.

roles.name: Gem
roles.description: A collectable that disappears when a player lands on the tile it occupies.

roles.name: Decoration
roles.description: A visible object with no special movement behavior.

roles.name: Ice
roles.description: Immoveable but slippery. Things do not stop moving on ice but continue to slide (unless otherwise stopped by an immoveable force)

roles.name: Weightless Pushable
roles.description: A push block, but weightless. That is, the player may push many of these at once. They still fall, but they are weightless.

roles.name: Floor
roles.description: A solid piece, but the player may fall off of it.

roles.name: Player Lift
roles.description: A two-state purple lift. State 0 is a lowered slab; state 1 is a raised cube. A player entering it toggles the state and rides the platform.

roles.name: Orange Button
roles.description: A six-face pressure sensor. Every independently pressed button lowers every Orange Wall by one additional unit.

roles.name: Orange Wall
roles.description: The shared mechanism for Orange Face and Orange Cube objects. Each stores a nonnegative remaining-rise number; Orange Buttons increase it and released buttons let it decrease one step at a time.
